name: nekosune-codex
description: A configurable AI chat and coding workspace for OmniRoute, Ollama, web search, images and local voice services.

nekosuneCodex.api.baseUrl.description: OmniRoute or OpenAI-compatible API base URL.

nekosuneCodex.api.model.description: Model ID accepted by the configured API gateway.

nekosuneCodex.apiKey.description: API key for the configured gateway, if required. Prefer VS Code SecretStorage for sensitive production deployments.

nekosuneCodex.search.baseUrl.description: SearXNG base URL or custom search API URL.

nekosuneCodex.firecrawl.apiKey.description: Firecrawl API key, if required by your deployment.

nekosuneCodex.search.customPath.description: Path for a custom search API.

nekosuneCodex.voice.transcriptionProvide.description: Transcription server protocol. Vosk HTTP adapters may require a compatible wrapper.

nekosuneCodex.voice.transcriptionModel.description: Model field sent to OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoints.

nekosuneCodex.voice.ttsUrl.description: Piper HTTP service URL or OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech endpoint.

nekosuneCodex.voice.ttsMode.description: Piper HTTP wrapper or OpenAI-compatible speech endpoint.

nekosuneCodex.voice.ttsVoice.description: Voice name for the configured TTS service.

nekosuneCodex.images.enabled.description: Enable image generation through the configured API gateway.

nekosuneCodex.images.model.description: Image model ID supported by the configured gateway.

nekosuneCodex.agent.requireApprovalForEd.description: Require confirmation before applying AI-proposed file changes.

nekosuneCodex.agent.requireApprovalForTe.description: Require confirmation before running terminal commands.
